svg.title: Paired review time changes and Cohen's dz bootstrap distribution
svg.desc: The left panel connects each reviewer's before and after time. Most lines fall, while some rise. The right panel shows a bootstrap distribution centered near dz 0.53 with a 95 percent BCa interval from about 0.18 to 0.88.
